info.title: maf-doctor — a toolkit for Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF
info.description: MAF Doctor — a .NET global tool and MCP server for Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF). Diagnoses, explains, and auto-fixes MAF agents and workflows: A-F health grades, deterministic Roslyn rewriters, anti-pattern and fan-out scanning, and a self-updating obsolete-API registry. Use it from Copilot / Claude / Cursor via MCP, or standalone as a CLI.
